core_obligations: (1) implies (2): condition (1) of the R-lemma gives the monomorphism Spec(k) -> X; then Spec(k) x_X U is etale over Spec(k) with finitely many points, hence finite nonempty over k.
(2) implies (1): the fibre of |U| -> |X| over x equals |Spec(k) x_X U|, finite; the fibre of |R| -> |X| equals the underlying set of (Spec(k) x_X U) x_k (Spec(k) x_X U), finite over k.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the R-lemma for the monomorphism; identify both fibres with finite schemes over k.
difficulty_reason: A two-identification argument anchored on the carded R-characterization.
